object.attr: derived: CF-V47, CF-V49 (D-V30). git merges changes that don't touch adjacent lines by itself, so a description can combine edits nobody wrote and Mellon's resolver never runs. Answered on 2026-11-11 (Q-V1), to confirm: document files are marked -merge; TEAM.md and mellon-check are handed to Process and CHECK.
object.description: If the repository's git attributes let git merge a file in a document folder as text, the Project Explorer shall warn and show the `.gitattributes` line that stops git merging the file as text.
